🎥🎬: BEHEMOTH! (2026)

Pedro Pascal stars as Alex Serian, a gifted cellist who returns to Los Angeles after spending 20 years travelling the world. As he reconnects with his family and the life he left behind, he begins to reflect on the sacrifices he made in pursuit of his musical dreams.

With old relationships to rebuild and unresolved memories resurfacing, Alex finds himself on an emotional journey of rediscovery. Through music, family, and unexpected encounters, he begins to understand that success means little without the people and connections that make life meaningful.

A heartfelt story about identity, family, second chances, and finding your way back home.

source_details.synopsis: Behemoth! is a 2026 American drama film written and directed by Tony Gilroy. It stars Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, and Will Arnett. The film premiered at the 64th New York Film Festival on October 2, 2026, and received positive reviews from critics for Pascal's performance, Gilroy's direction, and the musical score but received criticism for its writing and structure. It is scheduled to be released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on December 4, 2026.
